$description: Aethryna colour palette bank. Each palette follows the 60/30/10 rule: dominant (60%), secondary (30%), accent (10%). 'observed' records how the reference landing page actually distributes the colours.

palettes.name: Late Sets
palettes.mood: Jazz club, risograph print, nightlife, editorial
palettes.observed: 60-40 / 40-40-20 (teal headline + info block and large pink hero image push teal and pink well past 30/10)
palettes.notes: Grain/halftone textures suit it. To hit true 60/30/10, shrink the pink hero image or render it duotone teal with pink only on the CTA.

palettes.name: Fired Twice
palettes.observed: 80-20 overall, 60-30-10 by role (clay background dominates; brown is mostly type; turquoise only in the glaze)
palettes.notes: Brown works best as text/linework rather than fills. Keep turquoise rare — it should feel like the glaze.

palettes.name: Ribbon Finals
palettes.mood: Sport, performance, premium events, bold contrast
palettes.observed: 70-30 / 60-30-10 — the cleanest application of the rule of the three
palettes.notes: Dark-mode friendly. Ivory for headlines and nav, gold for motion/hero accents and primary CTA.

palettes.name: Drift
palettes.observed: 60-30-10 by role; the glowing jellyfish pushes orange towards ~20%
palettes.notes: Orange glows against the deep blue. Use it for the script headline word and glow effects; foam white for body type and outline buttons.

palettes.name: Zesty
palettes.observed: 60-30-10, but here lavender is the 30 and charcoal is the 10 (the reverse of the swatch order)
palettes.notes: The can sets the accent. Lavender for the big type, can and CTA circle; charcoal only for nav, small labels and one word of the headline.

palettes.name: Hanare
palettes.mood: Ryokan, hospitality, Japanese minimal, calm luxury
palettes.observed: ~60-10-30: the vermilion parasol takes far more than 10%, while indigo appears only as type
palettes.notes: The accent comes from the hero object (the parasol). Indigo works as an elegant serif type colour; keep vermilion to the image and a single 'Book a night' tag.

palettes.name: Glacier
palettes.observed: 70-30 / 60-30-10, photo-led: the ice cave gives the blue
palettes.notes: Spaced uppercase type in bone, with glacier blue on one keyword ('GLACIER'). Outline CTA buttons.

palettes.name: Deep Seats
palettes.observed: ~50-20-30: the green sofa is large, but complementary contrast keeps it balanced
palettes.notes: Pairs complementary purple and green. Condensed plum display type; green only through the product photo and maybe a small 'in stock' state.
